lessons.title: Observational Methods: Naturalistic vs. Structured Observation
lessons.description: Examine high ecological validity, participant vs. non-participant roles, and objective behavioral coding schemes.

lessons.title: Participant Reactivity & Observer Bias
lessons.description: Counter the Hawthorne effect, expectancy distortions, and demand characteristics using blind raters and habituation.

lessons.title: Case Studies & Archival Research
lessons.description: Learn from rare idiographic cases (H.M., Phineas Gage), archival datasets, and recognize the boundaries of generalizability.

lessons.title: Qualitative Methodologies & Thematic Analysis
lessons.description: Explore semi-structured interviews, focus groups, inductive coding, thematic analysis, and qualitative triangulation.
